title: Heterogeneous multi-literature data-driven modelling of coagulation defluoridation
description:
Data, analysis code and result tables for a study that compiles 1,011 coagulation-defluoridation records from 27 literature-derived groups (22 independent publications) and evaluates random-split performance, source-isolated generalization, applicability boundaries and model interpretation.

Contents: the model-ready matrix (1,011 records x 28 fields), the compiled dataset with its literature-source mapping, the Python analysis scripts, the result tables behind the reported metrics, and the eight main figures. Code is released under the MIT License; data and result tables under CC BY 4.0.
